answer_text: NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN on an IPsec tunnel often indicates a transform mismatch (Phase 1 or Phase 2) or an AWS configuration/template mismatch after changes. Check the tunnel Timeline (Review Tunnel Timeline) to confirm the event, and verify that the chosen P1 and P2 transforms on your side match the peer (and the AWS template if AWS is in use). If needed, enable IPsec packet captures under Network > Site > Site Configuration > IPsec to collect trace data for further troubleshooting.
